answer.thought: The air is hazy, a brown veil over the city that feels less like weather and more like the atmosphere of the file itself. I have settled Ramesh’s accounts, a necessary friction, but my body is stiff from the night’s restless sleep. I will take the papers to the verandah; the headlines speak of a world still turning, even if my own history has stalled in the Directorate’s corridors.
